doc: Provenance for the vendored upstream Pocock skill bases (issue #3994, ADR-0030 Decision 4 / Option C). A SIDECAR manifest, not an in-file header: a comment above a vendored file's frontmatter makes scripts/sync-skills.sh FAIL LOUD ('compose_base ... has no frontmatter'), and keeping the captures byte-faithful to upstream is what makes a content diff against the installed skill exact. Read by scripts/ci/vendor-drift-check.ts.

shaStatus.verified: upstreamSha was recorded at capture time from the installed plugin's gitCommitSha — a SHA comparison against the registry is meaningful.
shaStatus.unverified: captured before provenance stamping existed (or from a pre-plugin `npx skills add --copy` install). The upstream commit is NOT known, so no SHA comparison is possible until the next re-vendor establishes one. The drift checker reports these as needing a baseline re-vendor rather than silently treating them as current.

code-review.md.note: Body is byte-identical to the installed copy apart from the disable-model-invocation frontmatter line.

to-tickets.md.note: Vendored by #3992 from the local installed copy — the plugin was not installed at capture time.

improve-codebase-architecture.md.note: Vendored by #3993 from the local installed copy — the plugin was not installed at capture time. This base is the FIRST vendored outside the ADR-0030 spine: hydra-architecture-scan had hand-copied its steps 1-2 as prose since #788 and had already rotted (it cited LANGUAGE.md / INTERFACE-DESIGN.md siblings that do not exist under this skill — upstream moved that vocabulary into the separate codebase-design skill).
